header: A poster image with a play button
bodytext:
The video loads only when someone clicks play. It sits in a closed dialog, which the browser neither shows nor loads until it opens.

The link field holds the video URL, not a page. The note holds the running time, and the caption holds the credit.
caption: The caption is the credit line under the poster.
